authentication_methods.method: Setting API key as environment variable
authentication_methods.details: Set `GEMINI_API_KEY` or `GOOGLE_API_KEY`. `GOOGLE_API_KEY` takes precedence if both are set. Recommended for use with Gemini API libraries.
examples: Windows: Set `GEMINI_API_KEY` in system environment variables

authentication_methods.details: Directly include the API key in your code. Suitable for simple API calls, environments without environment variables (e.g., web), or REST calls. Not recommended for hardcoding in production client-side code due to security risks.

security_best_practices: Never commit API keys to source control.
Never expose API keys on the client-side (web/mobile apps in production).
Use server-side calls with API keys.
Consider using ephemeral tokens for client-side access (Live API only).
Add restrictions to API keys to limit permissions.
